title: Multitask Prompted Training Enables Zero-Shot Task Generalization
authors: V. Sanh, A. Webson, C. Raffel, et al. (~40 authors)
before: Instruction tuning was being explored inside large industrial labs.
problem: Nobody outside those labs had the prompts, the data or the models to study it.
breakthrough: An open collection of prompt templates across tasks, plus openly released instruction-tuned models.
why: It made instruction tuning reproducible in the open, months before ChatGPT made it famous.
next: The prompt collections fed the Flan collection and later open instruction datasets.
inherits: Open instruction data as shared infrastructure.
